name: What should I prepare or consider before my initial design-build consultation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare or consider before my initial design-build consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your initial design-build consultation with AKN Design Group, consider gathering any inspiration photos, rough ideas of your desired functionality, and a general understanding of your project's scope. Thinking about your lifestyle, aesthetic preferences, and how you envision using the redesigned space will be beneficial. While detailed plans aren't necessary, having a clear idea of your needs and priorities helps us understand your vision for customized renovations, enabling a more productive discussion about design possibilities and project goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before your consultation, gather inspiration photos, outline desired functionality, and consider your lifestyle and aesthetic preferences to help define your project vision.
